evidence: Men typically wear blue waistcoats with embroidery and fringes, striped trousers, and decorated Krakuska hats adorned with ribbons and peacock feathers, along with metal buckles on their belts. The Lachy Sądeckie ethnic costume is prevalent in southern Małopolska, especially in the Nowosądecki district and the Kotlina Sądecka region.
